mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_final_snapshots (travel_plan_id, title, start_date, end_date, representative_image_url) VALUES (#{travelPlanId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{representativeImageUrl})
INSERT INTO travel_plan_final_members (snapshot_id, user_id, display_name, role) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{role})
INSERT INTO travel_plan_final_days (snapshot_id, day_number, plan_date) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{dayNumber}, #{planDate})
INSERT INTO travel_plan_final_items (final_day_id, content, tag, display_order) VALUES (#{finalDayId}, #{content}, #{tag}, #{displayOrder})
INSERT INTO travel_plan_final_item_alternatives (final_item_id, alternative_order, condition_label, content, tag) VALUES (#{finalItemId}, #{alternativeOrder}, #{conditionLabel}, #{content}, #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM travel_plan_final_snapshots WHERE travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_plan_final_members m JOIN travel_plan_final_snapshots s ON s.id = m.snapshot_id WHERE s.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND m.hidden_at IS NULL

SELECT s.travel_plan_id AS travel_plan_id, s.id AS snapshot_id, s.title, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.representative_image_url, s.finalized_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_plan_final_members c WHERE c.snapshot_id = s.id) AS member_count FROM travel_plan_final_snapshots s JOIN travel_plan_final_members m ON m.snapshot_id = s.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.hidden_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.finalized_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.travel_plan_id, s.title, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.representative_image_url, s.finalized_at, s.created_at FROM travel_plan_final_snapshots s JOIN travel_plan_final_members m ON m.snapshot_id = s.id WHERE s.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.hidden_at IS NULL

SELECT id, snapshot_id, user_id, display_name, role, hidden_at, created_at FROM travel_plan_final_members WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN role = 'OWNER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, display_name ASC
SELECT id, snapshot_id, day_number, plan_date, created_at FROM travel_plan_final_days WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY day_number ASC

SELECT i.id, i.final_day_id, i.content, i.tag, i.display_order, i.created_at FROM travel_plan_final_items i JOIN travel_plan_final_days d ON d.id = i.final_day_id WHERE d.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY d.day_number ASC, i.display_order ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.final_item_id, a.alternative_order, a.condition_label, a.content, a.tag, a.created_at FROM travel_plan_final_item_alternatives a JOIN travel_plan_final_items i ON i.id = a.final_item_id JOIN travel_plan_final_days d ON d.id = i.final_day_id WHERE d.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY a.final_item_id ASC, a.alternative_order ASC
